name: Archon
description: A creature type for mystical celestial beings aligned with white, with obscured faces, always on a flying steed.

description_citations.text: "Archon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In ancient times the archons of Theros hold a massive empire in the Age of Trax, tyrannizing the world in the belief they imposed strict justice, until their empires fall.
timeline.quote: the archons of Theros held a massive empire, tyrannizing the world in the belief that they were imposing strict justice.

citation.text: "Archon", section "Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Heliod takes pity on an archon and gives it a spear in exchange for the rule of law in the wildest places.
timeline.quote: Heliod took pity on the archon and gave it a spear almost as radiant as his own

citation.text: "Archon", section "Archon of Falling Stars". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Wildered Quest an Eldraine archon watches and protects the Kenrith twins from redcaps.
timeline.quote: an archon watched the Kenrith twins from the trees and protected them from redcaps

citation.text: "Archon", section "Eldraine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Some despondent archons take refuge in the Underworld and are twisted into monstrous variants.
timeline.quote: Some of the despondent archons took refuge in the Underworld

citation.text: "Archon", section "Ashen Riders". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Most notable archon tyrant of Theros.
relations.quote: The most notable of these Archon tyrants was Agnomakhos
